name: Local AI
author: 0xSero
description: Run the model validated for your GPU and open a coding agent on it. One tested model per card for 36 cards (NVIDIA RTX 30/40/50, RTX Ada and Pro, Intel Arc Pro B70, AMD ROCm), weights checked against the Hub, the engine in a container behind a keyed gateway on 127.0.0.1. Opens pi, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, omp, Crush, Grok, Copilot or Hermes on it without touching their config. Shows GPU memory, temperature, speed and tokens.
